base:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production preset quest action illustration for PENTAPHOR, a personal routine app. One standalone reusable square illustration, not a presentation board or contact sheet.
Art direction: an expressive action pictogram enlarged into a miniature editorial illustration. The PERSON MUST BE EXTREMELY SIMPLE, like universal public signage: circular featureless head, solid geometric torso and thick limbs, no eyes, face, hair, fingers, clothing folds, muscles, or character design. The ACTION must be richly legible through carefully drawn props, silhouette, posture, and 2-3 restrained motion marks. Sophisticated angular cut-paper screenprint look, bold silhouette, crisp vector-like edges, striking diagonal composition, subtle ink texture only within shapes. No cute cartoon, no realistic anatomy, no 3D, no gradients, no manga character.
Palette strictly warm ivory #F3EEDC for the main person's silhouette, vibrant teal #35D6BE and deep ink #121916 for props and contrasting internal cuts, optional tiny muted gold #D8B765 accent under 3%. Main silhouette must be readable on the app's dark ink background. Do not put dark strokes around all the ivory shapes. Maintain a consistent visual language of geometric signage heads/limbs with more detailed equipment.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no opaque square, no checkerboard drawn in, no frame or badge, no background scenery, no text or letters, no logo, no labels or watermark. Compact complete scene centered with all parts within 12% safe margins; illustration fills roughly 76% of square, suitable for display at 96-200px and larger achievement screen. Request 1024x1024 square PNG.
